Emergency Offline Policy & Licensing

A terminal (POS, Captain, Kiosk) locks itself after 7 days with no contact with JAMANVAAR, so a stolen or cancelled device cannot keep running forever. When a restaurant's internet is genuinely down past that limit, grant one of its terminals a signed certificate here: a few extra offline days, cryptographically signed (ECDSA P-256) so the terminal can verify it without the internet, the same way it verifies its licence.
